name: Haldor Ironmonger
note: A Deepdelver; the Ashgate Forge, and the best upgrades in the Provinces, which he will tell you himself (world doc §3.3, v1.53). At the forge by day, the Slag & Bellows by night. Gives the fighters' trial at 24 and (v1.155) Tamsin's chain, Showing Off: she swept his floor once.
